policies.stealth_attack: stealth_lost with reason=attack is emitted for ordinary and forced attacks before the attack window. Trigger context is a detached capture. CAP_000/005 require original friendly minion; CAP_006 accepts either player. Hand progress native event amount=one and completed once; no retroactive acquisition.
policies.blackblood: Actual HEALING and healed>0, source_controller=owner. Capture original BoardPresenceReference from captured trigger context; AttackRandomEnemyMinion validates original presence before RNG. No trigger from overheal, max-health gains, enemy restoration, or attempted conversion. Appendage sides are explicit local policy, M6 pending. Appendage declaration is t1 left, t2/t3 right in original order; not CN calibrated.
policies.windrunners: Register FabledSpec with the original two companions. Reuse existing Fabled representative policy: one repetition for each actual qualified sibling play returned by public played_cards, before current play id when present, without arbitrary two-repeat cap. Pure battlecry invocation contributes no play fact. Count accepted once; each actual damage/deck group reads fresh state. Per-play counting and cutoff remain explicit internal policy pending M6.
policies.mask: Original minion ref for 8/10 and Lifesteal; before attacker RNG validate original target BoardPresence. Select complete live enemy minion refs once; native ForceAttack guards both original presences.
policies.staff: Original completed hero attack; native Discover restricted to specified DRUID class with include_neutral=False, even under another hero class. Discount is hero Attack in original attack-finished context. Last durability follows captured native window; M6 pending.
policies.nespirah: Successful own FEL spell completion across physical cast origins. Refresh uses frozen LocationFaceReference and fresh automatic continuation guard; no stale residence rebinding. Natural location death/last durability summons named unshackled body. Non-Colossal Naga generation excludes exactly complete printed COLOSSAL identities from fixed full raw source; excludes no eligible candidates based on registered coverage. Cost=1 via native creation.
policies.cache: Independent immutable frozen writer/reader registry instances keyed complete fixture configuration and complete adapter/test/batch fingerprint; no GameState caching.
